$comment: Glossary for L-13 (doc 06 §3.7, §4.3; doc 08 §7.2; R64). Sources: doc 08 §7.2.1 tables T-A–T-E (pt-BR column = the app's own names, xcstrings pt-BR), §7.2.2 website rules ①–③ and the pt-BR row of §7.3.

Quota-table rows follow the app's Free/Plus comparison screen (FeatureQuotaManager.swift featureDisplayName) in short form, so the first column stays ≤ 3 lines on a 375 px phone: 'Deslize para Traduzir · nuvem / local' (= daily_sentence_translation_limit + engine), 'Toque duas vezes para procurar' (word_meaning_lookup_title without '(Significado AI)'), ai_pronunciation_word / _sentence and more_definitions_title verbatim, 'Explicação de Sintaxe de IA' (get_syntax_explanation_button without 'Obter', as en 'AI syntax explanation' comes from 'Get AI Syntax Explanation'). Action Flow keeps the App Store name (doc 08 D3); the text quotes the app's 'Fluxo de ações da frase' once.

§7.2.2 lists no pt-BR fixes (X1–X13). Rule ①: kickers, quota-table rows, demo.ui.more and 'tap … in the app' instructions use the app's names verbatim ('Leitura AI', 'Pronúncia AI (Palavra)' keep the app's 'AI'); rule ②: sentences use natural Brazilian Portuguese (você; 'deslize … para a direita', 'toque duas vezes'; 'IA' in running text).

Kicker of features[lookup] = the app's word_meaning_lookup_title without the '(Significado AI)' suffix, as en / ja / zh-Hant do; it is 30 characters (> the 24 wu kicker cap of doc 08 §7.6, an L-8 warning) — see docs/redesign-2026/ops/m3/pt-BR-qa.md.
